Programın ana esin kaynağı. Kart düşürme: The main inspiration for this app. The idea that cards can be farmed without opening a Steam client, simply by reporting a game as "being played", came from here. Studying its approach taught us how to build the queue and in what order it makes sense to handle games.
A maintained fork of Idle Master. After the original project was abandoned we followed this one to see what changed on Steam's side and which behaviours still hold; it also showed which settings are actually worth exposing to the user.
Saat yükseltme tarafındaki esin kaynağım: Our inspiration on the hour-boosting side. From its approach we learned that several games can be held open at once and what that means for playtime accrual. This is why the Hour Booster tab exists.
Başarımların oyun açılmadan okunup değiş: The project that showed achievements can be read and changed without launching the game. It helped us understand how the achievement schema and unlock state are stored on Steam's side; the Achievements tab was built on that idea with our own code.

Arayüz ekran kartıyla çizilir. Kapatmak: The interface is drawn by the graphics card. Turning this off shrinks the graphics process and, in our measurements, cut memory use by roughly 45 MB, at the cost of drawing on the CPU. Also turn it off if you see visual glitches or freezing, then restart the app.

Oyun saatlerce oynanmış ama başarım açıl: When a game has hours on it but no achievements unlocked, a backlog has built up. With this on, that backlog is cleared during the first fifth of the session and the pace then returns to normal. How large the backlog is depends on the playtime: a few achievements on a one hour game, far more on a hundred hour one.

Pencere ekranda durup odakta değilken sa: While the window sits on screen without focus, the per-second updates and the spinning animations stop. Sharing a desktop with a fullscreen game, this lets the desktop compositor leave the game its presentation path, so the frame rate holds. Background work is untouched; only drawing stops.
Chromium, arayüzü çizerken Windows üzeri: Chromium draws the interface through D3D11 on Windows. Some Intel and older AMD drivers stall on that path; D3D9 or OpenGL fixes it. Automatic is whatever Chromium picks. Changing this needs a restart.
Kapalıyken pencerenin kareleri işlemcide: With this off the window’s frames are composited on the processor and the graphics card is never touched. It leaves the card entirely to your game, at the cost of a few points of CPU. Needs a restart.
Oyun kapak görselleri ve indirilen sayfa: Game cover art and downloaded page assets are dropped from memory and disk. No settings, session or statistics are lost; everything removed is fetched again when needed. On a long running session this is the most direct way to get memory back.

Açıkken oturum süresi ayarlardan hesapla: When on, the session length is derived from the settings: how long a real player would take to earn the remaining achievements. It is clamped between fifteen minutes and twelve hours. If you type a value into the duration field, automatic assignment stays off for that session.
Buradaki ayarlar uygulamanın geneline ve: These settings apply to the whole app and to every connected Steam account.

Seçili oyunların toplam oynanma süreleri: Brings the total playtime of the selected games up to the same target. Games below the target run together; each one drops out when it reaches the target, the rest keep going, and boosting stops once all of them are there. Before starting you see when each game will finish and the total time, and you are asked to confirm.
İstatistikler hesaba özeldir; ekrandaki: Statistics are per account; the totals shown are for the account on screen. The sale count and average refer to listings you created; Steam does not report whether they sold. The average is the amount you receive after Steam's fee. Uninterrupted run is the longest time a task kept running without a break longer than a minute.
Hızlı modda aynı anda açık tutulan oyun: How many games fast mode keeps open at once: the warm-up batch and the rotation pool are this size. The other modes run games one by one. Steam's known limit is 32; you can pick fewer.
Hızlı mod dışındaki modlarda bir oyunun: In every mode except fast mode, how long a game stays open before moving on to the next one. A game with no cards left leaves the queue without waiting. The Card Farming page opens with this time.
Açıkken bir oyunun süresi dolunca ya da: When on, the queue moves to the next game once a game's time is up or its cards run out. When off, farming stops at that game and waits to be started again.
\"Satışa Sun\" düğmesinin başlangıç fiya: The starting price for the "List for sale" button. Undercutting the lowest listing sells fastest; the average price earns more but you may wait longer for a buyer.
\"Fiyatları otomatik yenile\" açıkken fi: How often prices are fetched again from Steam while "Refresh prices automatically" is on. Frequent refreshing keeps prices current but brings you closer to Steam's request limit.
Varsayılan satış fiyatı \"En ucuzun altı: How far below the lowest listing to go when the default selling price is "Undercut the lowest". A small value protects your earnings; a large one sells faster.
Toplu satış bu kadar öğelik partilere bö: Bulk sales are split into batches of this many items; 0 means no batches, listing continues until Steam stops it. Steam's listing limit depends on the account: new accounts can be stopped after 10-15 listings, while older, trusted accounts can list more than 80 at once. If Steam returns an error, selling always stops and you are told why.
Bir parti bitince sonraki parti bu süre: After a batch finishes, the next one is listed automatically after this long. If "Ask me after every batch" is selected, your confirmation is needed to continue. Spreading listings over time makes Steam less likely to stop accounts with a low limit.
Bir öğenin en düşük ilanı Steam'in 24 sa: When an item's lowest listing falls this far below Steam's 24-hour average, it is marked with a red ▼ in the inventory, the sale confirmation shows a red warning, and you get a notification if "Price drop alert" is on.
Listelemeden önce öğe sayısı, alıcının ö: Before listing, you see the number of items, the total the buyer pays and what you receive after Steam's fee. If the Steam Guard mobile authenticator is on, each listing also waits for confirmation in the Steam app; SteamEdge cannot confirm it for you.
Bu oturumda satışa sunduğun öğeler envan: Items you listed during this session are hidden from the inventory list so you do not list the same item twice. Steam sometimes updates the inventory with a delay.
Saat Yükseltici sayfasının süresi. Kayde: The duration used on the Hour Booster page. When you save, the page's duration is set to this value too. With Unlimited, the session runs until you stop it.
Eş zamanlı yükseltmede oyunlar hepsi bir: When boosting simultaneously, games are started one after another at this interval instead of all at once. Only affects starting.
Yalnızca sıralı bekletmede geçerli: oyun: Only for sequential idling: since games are opened one at a time, the order shows on your profile, so each round opens them in a different order. With simultaneous boosting all games are open together and there is no order.
Açıkken saat yükseltme ya da Gerçekçi Mo: When on, card farming pauses while hour boosting or Realistic Mode runs and resumes where it left off afterwards. When off, both run together on the same account; Steam counts at most 32 games at once.
Kapalıyken Saat Yükseltici seçili oyunla: When off, the Hour Booster runs the selected games together until the time is up. When on, games below the target run together and each one drops out when it reaches the target. Syncing does not apply in sequential idling mode. Sync settings take effect the next time you start.
The wait between two achievement unlocks. With safe mode on it varies randomly around this value each time; with it off it is applied exactly. A longer interval looks more natural but slows down bulk unlocking.
Açılış aralığına her seferinde rastgele: Adds a random variation to the unlock interval each time, so unlocks never follow a fixed rhythm.
Tek bir başarımı açarken ya da kilitlerk: Asks for confirmation when you unlock or lock a single achievement. "Don't ask again" in the confirmation window turns this off; you can turn it back on here.
Bir başarım açıldığında ya da kilitlendi: Shows a notification when an achievement is unlocked or locked.
Bağlantı kopması, oturum reddi ve satış: Connection drops, rejected sessions and sale errors are reported right away. Turning this off is not recommended.
Envanterindeki bir öğenin en düşük ilanı: Notifies you when an item in your inventory has its lowest listing fall below Steam's 24-hour average by Market > Price drop threshold. At most once a day per item.
Aşağıda belirlediğin aralıkta hiçbir bil: No notifications are shown during the period set below, not even errors. The in-app activity log keeps recording.
Sessiz saatler açıkken bildirim gösteril: Start and end of the period without notifications while quiet hours are on.
İnternet giderse, Steam çökerse ya da ba: If your internet drops, Steam goes down or the connection is cut unexpectedly, the session is restored automatically and running tasks continue where they left off. The wait between attempts grows each time (up to 5 minutes). If the login token is no longer valid or the account was taken over by another session, it does not retry and tells you why.
Bu süre boyunca uygulamada hiçbir tıklam: If there is no click or key press in the app for this long, all Steam sessions are closed and you return to the login screen. This does not happen while card farming, hour boosting or Realistic Mode is running on any account. It has nothing to do with dropped connections; the setting above handles those.
Uygulamanın olay kaydı cache klasöründek: The app's event log is written to steamedge.log in the cache folder. Attaching this file when reporting a problem speeds up the fix. The detailed level uses more disk space; only choose it while troubleshooting.
Steam pazarına gönderilen fiyat ve satış: The shortest gap between price and sales history requests to the Steam Market. A lower value fetches prices faster but raises the risk of hitting Steam's request limit (HTTP 429); if that happens, increase it.
Steam kesintisi sonrası eline geçecek tu: What you receive after Steam's fee, calculated with Steam's own fee formula
